title: British Pound gives back UK sales pop as Oil shock returns
summary: The Pound Sterling retraces after reaching a daily high of 1.3375 on upbeat UK data, as headlines suggest that an oil supply shock has sent crude prices higher and reignited investors' fears of high inflation. The GBP/USD trades at 1.3356, down 0.03%.

title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Technical setup favours further gains above 100
summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) climbs to a fresh seven-week high on Friday, supported by the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) hawkish interest rate hike on Wednesday. At the time of writing, the index trades around 100.40 and is on track to register a weekly gain of more than 1%.
